entries.ed6d05882df15909: Its mission is to 'develop and provide software that is competitive worldwide,' and it aims to create social value as a 'Tsunagu Expert.' Its basic approach is to provide products it plans itself rather than contract development, and it places its key areas of investment and R&D on '4D' (Data, Device, Decentralized, Design). Its policy is to work on making products AI-native, expanding into growth areas such as physical AI and digital currency, strengthening overseas expansion, and strengthening its talent base.
